context: M21 o3b (burned branch). Delroy's cab idling on W 37th.

lines.speaker: char.delroy_tate
lines.text: Night man's a drinker. Nine-oh-five he goes to the deli for 'coffee.' Twenty minutes.

lines.speaker: char.delroy_tate
lines.text: Freight stairs come out on Thirty-Seventh. I'll be here. Meter off.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: How do you know his habits?

lines.speaker: char.delroy_tate
lines.text: I drive Lisle on weekends. Car service. Man tips like a tax collector.
